reference.citation: scipy.signal.detrend (Virtanen et al. 2020); least-squares linear/constant detrending. Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the linear and constant detrend with scipy.signal.detrend (bit-exact) and quantifies the spectral leakage -- the sub-1-Hz Welch power of the raw, linear-detrended, and constant-detrended signal -- reporting the scipy agreement, the removed slope, the three low-frequency powers, and the linear-vs-constant leakage reduction
